answers.observation: The ball has procedural grain and three readable channels; each bottle has a distinct base, body, shoulder, neck, cap and label band.
The tighter impact frame makes ball-to-front-bottle contact immediately legible while retaining the two downstream targets.
All three bottles are separately readable before impact and after settling, with distinct fall directions and non-overlapping silhouettes.
Soft contact shadows under the setup, compressed contact region and long settled shadows make gravity and rest state visible.
Warm key and cool fill retain rubber grain, glossy bottle highlights, label colors and dark caps without clipping the subjects.
The three images now function as establish, contact and consequence rather than repeated fixed-space views.

limitations: This is a controlled curriculum film, not an advertisement-quality final: bottle geometry remains intentionally simple.
The exact contact still has no motion blur, deformation, secondary particles or sound; those are later lessons, not hidden acceptance criteria.
One accepted scene does not prove generalization; an unseen shape/count variation is required before returning to the robot capstone.
